name: Matar Mushroom
steps: Wipe mushrooms clean and halve them; do not soak them in water. Boil peas for 3–4 minutes until almost tender and drain.
Heat oil in a wide pan, add cumin and onion, and cook 7 minutes until golden. Stir in ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomato, coriander powder, turmeric, chili and salt. Cook 7–8 minutes until tomato breaks down and oil shows at the edges.
Add mushrooms and stir-fry 5 minutes until their released moisture mostly evaporates. Add peas and 150 ml water; simmer 5 minutes until both are tender.
Taste and adjust salt, then scatter coriander leaves. Serve this semi-dry curry hot with chapati or rice.
tips: Brown mushrooms before adding water for a fuller flavor.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
